description: After the migration the live Matters header row is exactly 14 columns with unmapped_facts_json in position N.
why_it_exists: WF2's Finalise Plan writes the unmapped-fact audit copy to this column by name, and Upsert Matter maps it positionally. Position 14 is asserted, not just presence, because an insert elsewhere would shift every later column.
assertions: header[13] is 'unmapped_facts_json' and header.length is exactly 14.
Presence alone is not sufficient - the confirmation fails if the column exists at any other index.
The confirmation reads the live header row back over HTTP rather than trusting the n8n cached node schema.
target_unresolved_reason: kind is "schema": not executed by harness/run.js.
